title: feat: quality preset is 160 mbps, display rate off

commit.merge_subject: merge: feat: quality preset is 160 mbps, display rate off

description: Owner decisions 2026-11-25 after the device measurements. (1) Quality preset = 160 Mb/s for HEVC: a new QUALITY bitrate level on the table's own pixel-rate scaling (factor 5.13: 160.0 at 4K30 HEVC, ~49 at 1080p30, capped at the encoder's listed ceiling so 4K60 reads 160 too); the preset falls back to the old MAX when there is no HEVC encoder; MAX and the ladder keep their values; the sub-page lists QUALITY only while it is current, 200/240 stay reachable as Custom with uncapped. A saved old Quality (MAX) now reads as Custom, which is honest. (2) The display-rate request is off by default (ENABLED_BY_DEFAULT = false, interleaved A/B showed no benefit); code and flags stay, debug can enable it with files/debug-display-rate. Tests updated and added (+3 +1).
changed: feat: quality preset is 160 mbps, display rate off
